book_meta.work: short stories by Guy de Maupassant and Anton Chekhov
book_meta.author: Maupassant (d. 1893) and Chekhov (d. 1904)
book_meta.status: public domain — retold from the plots, not from any translation

sentences.ar: بحفلة، صار نقاش عن الإعدام والسجن المؤبد.
sentences.en: At a party, an argument arose about execution and life imprisonment.
A young lawyer said: prison is more merciful.
A wealthy banker said: will you bet?

sentences.ar: قال المحامي: بقعد خمستعش سنة لحالي.
sentences.en: The lawyer said: I will sit fifteen years alone.

sentences.ar: حبس حاله ببيت بالحديقة، وما شاف حدا.
sentences.en: He shut himself in a house in the garden, and saw nobody.

sentences.ar: بالسنين الأولى، طلب كتب موسيقى وروايات.
sentences.en: In the first years, he asked for music books and novels.
And then he asked for philosophy and languages and history.

sentences.ar: بآخر ليلة، المصرفي كان صار فقير.
sentences.en: On the last night, the banker had become poor.
He thought of killing him so as not to pay.
He went in quietly and found a paper on the table.

sentences.ar: مكتوب فيها: قريت كل إشي، وما عاد بدي مصاريك.
sentences.en: It read: I have read everything, and I no longer want your money.
In the morning, they found the house empty.
